carol (acct exec): FYI MosaicLabs asking for a special pilot concession. They want 6 weeks of hosted inference at 65% off to test our embeddings+reranking for a marketplace launch. Theyre cash-strapped but promise a PO if POC succeeds. Can we do this quickly? :pray:
toni (finance ops): 65% is above our non-escalated threshold. Need pilot size, list ~$ numbers, and whether they want credits or net invoiced discount. Also any asks for retro credits if conversion happens?
carol (acct exec): Pilot estimate: 2.8M tokens + low embeddings (200k units). List estimate: inference $70k total. With 65% they'd pay $24.5k, concession ~$45.5k. They asked for the concession as a credit applied upfront. No ask for retroactive credit yet, but might request conversion credit discussion later.
adesh (revops): If it's an upfront credit, we need GL mapping and a hard cap. Recommend marking concession as marketing credit (GL: 5315) and set pilot credit cap = $40k. Also require non-refundable onboarding fee $2k and LOI with conversion KPI.
toni (finance ops): Agreed on cap. Also insist on pre-approval for any retroactive credits. If they ask later for conversion credit, that needs VP signoff and a documented concession memo.
claire (head of finance): We can conditionally approve up to 50% discount without VP signoff. Anything >50% requires VP review. Conditions: 1) Deal desk ticket, 2) signed LOI (evaluation scope & decision date), 3) SOW limiting data & duration, 4) GL code confirmed, 5) onboarding fee prepay. :white_check_mark:
harvey (legal): We'll need SOW and any data handling addendum if PII/PHI is present. Also recommend a clause preventing automatic conversion crediting unless VP approves. Legal turnaround ~48-72hrs.
carol (acct exec): Customer pushes back on onboarding fee but ok to sign LOI. Can we do 55% + $2k onboarding + $40k cap to keep within finance?
adash (revops): typo: adesh. If we move to 55% we still exceed non-escalation (still need VP if >50). Better to propose 50% with $40k cap and LOI.
claire (head of finance): Final: approve up to 50% off, pilot credit cap $40k, $2k onboarding fee required, deal desk ticket and LOI required. If Mosaic insists on 65%, escalate to VP for exception and include expected ARR uplift and conversion KPI in the ticket.
dealbot: /dealdesk create customer=MosaicLabs pilot_discount=50% pilot_cap=40000 onboarding_fee=2000 expected_ARR=90000 notes="embeddings+reranking POC, potential marketplace launch"
financebot: Checklist: 1) Deal desk URL, 2) Signed LOI (pdf), 3) SOW w/ data scope, 4) Confirm GL code. Finance will issue concession memo after receipt. Any retro credits or additional concessions must be documented and approved by VP.
toni (finance ops): I'll own the concession memo once docs are uploaded. Tag me in the deal desk ticket.
carol (acct exec): Will push LOI and try to capture the onboarding fee. If Mosaic insists on bigger concession, I'll escalate. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
